have now started the process of moving to another practice after over 20 years of being here. The Drs are happy to throw medication at you but not investigate the route cause of the issue, In my circumstance I am severely iron deficient now , The GP done a Qfit test which came back clear however my symptoms are getting worse, The Drs i have spoken to have told me the wrong information even though cancer reasearch UK says a clear Qfit test doesnt mean there is not problems , The Dr has told me it eliminates there being anything wrong, A specialist in this field told me the same as the cancer research website but the Dr told me he was also wrong, Academy street Drs seem to know best. Instead of sending me for further test Dr Quinn told me today there is nothing else they can do for me as he wanted to give me amitriptyline which i have tried and it didnt work. They are holding onto a CT scan done 5 years ago that was clear but obviously common sense doesnt get used by this practice as The CT scan is classed as out of date and alot can happen in 5 years. I want to thank the ladies that have taken my blood as they are very nice. Im 38 been left to rot by this practice, keen to get back to work and the gym but cannot with no help. How can the government also expect people to get better with Practices like this. This practice has also mixed up my file with another patient with the same name and put my mobile number on his file. Hopefully once i do move and get treated with more dignity there is nothing seriously wrong. This practice is a shambles. I refuse to be kept sick and just have medication thrown at me. I want to contribute to society but this practice is stopping me from doing so. I will leave the words on cancer research website here so maybe the practice manager or Drs can see and get with the times or stop thinking they know better than specialists.

"No blood in your poo
This means that no blood was found in your poo. Your doctor might call this FIT negative.

For most people this means that they don’t have cancer. But a normal FIT result doesn't completely rule out cancer. Some people can have cancer and a normal FIT result.

It’s important to go back to your GP if your symptoms continue, change, or get worse even if you have normal test results. Some people will need to have further tests."

The Dr told me this normal result means there is nothing wrong, So we dont go by symptoms anymore. Also Dr Sinclair at the Surgery told me i was not Iron deficient when blood tests clearly show I am..

Complaining is also a waste of time, they simply do not care

Avoid this practice at all
